theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Top-ranked theme with eligible trend-gate pass, but leadership rests on weak internals: mixed hurst, narrow breadth (0.25), low durability_bar (0.52), and a negative 10-day return (−1.5%). This is a fragile leader — levered to the AI-infrastructure narrative continuation but not supported by broad participation. Lean is conditional on breadth improving, not on rank.
evidence: breadth 0.25 — narrowest of any top-tier theme
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth and divergent value state suggest the theme is running on a handful of names, not a durable narrative — the negative 10-day return while holding the top rank is a classic topping texture for a fragile leader.
